Patient presents with a severe anterior open bite, bilateral posterior crossbite, moderate-to-severe upper crowding, and a Class II posterior AP relationship-- DO NOT attempt to correct these. 

Patient has denied surgery and fixed orthodontics that was presented by a specialist. 
Will accept a major compromise and just focusing on minor alignment. 

MAINTAIN AOB, MAINTAIN CROSSBITES

GOALS:
Align lower anterior (L3-3)
Improve alignment upper anterior (U3-3) but do not skew arch form-- Add IPR to resolve but do not overly procline to worsen AOB. 
Accept if U2s cannot be fully aligned with the U1s
